title: A write, a copy in the zone and a snapshot
claim: A volume serves its own Availability Zone, and its snapshots in Amazon S3 can rebuild it anywhere in the Region.
alt: A sequence with three participants: an EC2 instance, an EBS volume and Amazon S3. The instance writes blocks to the volume in its zone, EBS copies the volume inside that zone, a snapshot sends the changed blocks to Amazon S3, and a new volume is restored from it in another zone.

messages.label: Write block
messages.say: The instance writes a block to its EBS volume, which is off-instance storage.

messages.label: Same zone
messages.say: The volume and the instance must be in the same Availability Zone.

messages.label: Copy in zone
messages.say: The volume is automatically replicated within its Availability Zone.

messages.label: Snapshot copy
messages.say: A snapshot copies the blocks on the volume that have changed to Amazon S3.

messages.label: Many zones
messages.say: The snapshot is stored redundantly in multiple Availability Zones.

messages.label: Restore in any zone
messages.say: From the snapshot, you can restore volumes in any Availability Zones of the Region.
